items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001

ctx.x: Yeah, the woodwind quartet piece, I took first place. Well it was very interesting that one of the professors, Dr. Shields
He came to the lunch room and said, “Allan won the contest, and it wasn’t even jazz.” Which was interesting because in going to Fredonia, that was kind of a culture shock.
